items.title: I Believe Everything My Agents Tell Me: Three Levels of Review — Corey Gallon, Rexmore
items.content_snippet: A demand letter passed its drafting agent's own checks, yet two independent reviewer agents found that the supposedly expired contract had renewed less than three weeks earlier. Sending it could have left the business owing thousands of dollars. Corey Gallon uses that case to explain a three level review method for agents that overstate completed work, misread facts or draw the wrong conclusions.
